verdict.rationale: Xero offers AI features like JAX for bank reconciliation and bill-entry automation, plus an official MCP server and API/SDK that developers could use to build autonomous background agents, but these are largely semi-automated (drafts requiring approval) rather than self-running background automations, and there's no first-party 'automation/workflow scheduler' product documented. Missing for 10: evidence of a native scheduler or trigger-based automation engine, confirmation JAX or bill-entry runs without human approval steps, and independent verification of autonomous agentic operation.
